profile.headline: Lead Frontend Engineer & AI/UX Innovation Specialist, martini.ai
profile.summary: Front End Web Developer with a recently earned certificate in Full-Stack Development from UC Berkeley Extension focusing on Responsive Web Design that meets accessibility standards as well as utilizing the MERN stack. Acute sense of responsibility, organized, and attentive to detail, with an extensive track record working in customer service capacities across several industries. Ample experience with group work and adapting to different leadership, including recent work with a team of five to create a full-stack app for building personal and shared song lists for karaoke. I am particularly excited to learn more about and create responsive web designs/applications that meet accessibility standards and work with teams to creatively problem solve design solutions.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Improved responsiveness using Tailwind CSS breakpoints and custom React hooks for mobile and tablet adaptation.
Personalized graph components with Recharts library for labels, ticks, and legends.
Crafted custom graphs using Recharts and Tailwind CSS, adhering to designer specifications.
Seamlessly customized Cognito login page to match application theme, including colors, fonts, and styles.
Enhanced table components with TanStack/React-Tables package for optimization, sorting, filtering, and pagination.
Developed user Account page with dynamic editing, Cognito API integration for password reset, and tailored user privileges.
Worked in close collaboration with the Growth Manager to conceptualize and implement new features aimed at seamlessly integrating SEM campaigns.
positions.insights: Skills: Recharts · Amazon Cognito · React-Tables · Figma · CSS · Amplitude Analytics · Git · Tailwind CSS · JavaScript · Next.js · HTML5 · GitHub · Amplify · Django · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Modernized class components into functional components for optimized performance and adherence to industry practices.
Expertly managed authentication and CRUD operations, tailoring data rendering to user privileges.
Crafted intuitive and visually appealing UI/UX, emphasizing seamless user experience.
Refactored global and component-based styles for consistency and coherence in line with new designs.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · JavaScript · TypeScript · Teamwork · SASS · Ant Design · Material Ui · Communication · React.js · Skill Development
